existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 Device has multiple local hard breaks despite stable artifact identity. Top concerns are status semantics, moved patient/owner associations, and reshaped name/property/UDI/definition fields. Biggest uncertainty is lack of official cross-version mapping guidance.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration requires data transformation, not just version relabeling: resolve DeviceDefinition canonicals, backfill UDI fields, rename/retype backbones, split associations into DeviceAssociation, and preserve R6-only codes/types through extensions or loss policies when converting back to R4.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural deltas because local StructureDefinitions and indexes were compared. Confidence is medium for exact migration intent and terminology edge cases because official diffs, full narrative migration guidance, and full terminology expansions were not available.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Device keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 10 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 7 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 100/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

1 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Device.deviceName was reshaped to Device.name with changed child names and terminology
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `deviceName` and `deviceName.name` are not R6 element names, and R4 primitive codes require conversion to an R6 CodeableConcept and possibly new code semantics.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.patient and Device.owner were removed and moved to DeviceAssociation-style associations
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `patient` and `owner` properties are rejected on R6 Device; migration requires creating separate DeviceAssociation resources and updating APIs/searches.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.status changed from availability semantics to record status and statusReason was removed
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: the highest-risk mechanism is same-code semantic drift; additionally, R4 instances with `statusReason` are old-valid/new-invalid in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.specialization was replaced by Device.conformsTo
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `specialization` and `systemType` are not valid R6 paths; R6 `category` has no R4 base destination.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.url was removed with no same-path R6 replacement
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 Device with `url` is invalid against the R6 Device StructureDefinition, with no local R6 Device field to receive the value.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.version was renamed to Device.deviceVersion and gained installDate
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 `version` array is not an R6 `deviceVersion` array; generated models and persistence columns also change names.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: UDI carrier repetitions now require deviceIdentifier and issuer
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 `udiCarrier` repetition without `deviceIdentifier` or without `issuer` is rejected by R6; R6 `deviceIdentifierSystem` also has no R4 base field.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.property values changed from two repeating value elements to one required choice
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: empty R4 property repetitions and R4 `valueCode`/multi-value shapes are not valid as R6 `value[x]`; new R6 value types are lossy to base R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.definition changed from Reference(DeviceDefinition) to canonical(DeviceDefinition)
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: a valid R4 Reference object at `definition` is not valid against the R6 canonical primitive; R6-to-R4 may also require resolving a canonical to a concrete reference.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Device.distinctIdentifier was removed; biological traceability is now biologicalSourceEvent
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 string at `distinctIdentifier` is not valid in R6; R6 Identifier metadata such as system/type cannot be represented in the R4 string without loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
